verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen streaming and remote-control app. User-configurable background automations are a plausible capability for this kind of tool, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no way to create autonomous or scheduled automations: Launch at Login and the daily update check are built-in behaviors, not user-defined automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
